p2p-system-work.title: How does the P2P system work?

content.p1: Player to player system, as can be understood from its name, works between players. Players sell skins directly to other players, or buy from other players, but without being afraid of getting scammed or being affected by the 7-day trade ban. With this system, selling and buying transactions take only 5 minutes. And P2P system works for CS:GO.
